about.title: A senior engineer you can actually reach.
about.p1: I'm Jamie Nisbet, a software engineer and AI consultant based in {location}. I've spent years building software for the web, and I now design AI systems meant to run for the long term — well-defined, documented, and built to scale, not bolted-on demos that break a month later.
about.p2: I work as a small shop on purpose. You deal with the person writing the code, so decisions are quick and nothing gets lost in translation. For bigger builds I bring in trusted contractors — you keep the responsiveness and gain the capacity.
about.p3: Most of what I build has one job: take the admin and busywork off your plate, so your time goes back to the business and its customers. I care about doing the useful thing, explaining the why, and being straight about trade-offs and cost. If something's a bad idea, I'll tell you.
howIWork: You talk to the person building it — no agency layers, no account managers.
Clear scope and a clear price before we start; changes are a conversation, not a hidden line item.
I'm honest about trade-offs, cost, and what I don't know — I'd rather under-promise.
Built on clear, documented architecture — it scales as you grow and it's yours to keep, no lock-in.
One person you can reach, with contractors on standby for bigger builds.
